property_summary: For every advertised interface (IERC165, IERC1155, IERC1155MetadataURI), chosen by a fuzzed index, c.supportsInterface must return true; the mutant drops the IERC1155MetadataURI check so it returns false for the metadata interface.
change_summary: Remove the check against the IERC1155MetadataURI interface id so that calls with that id no longer return true.
